vsm2.13:72.1: Sattānaṃ cutūpapātañāṇakathāya cutūpapātañāṇāyāti (dī. ni. 1.247) cutiyā ca upapāte ca ñāṇāya.
vsm2.13:72.2: Yena ñāṇena sattānaṃ cuti ca upapāto ca ñāyati, tadatthaṃ dibbacakkhuñāṇatthanti vuttaṃ hoti.
vsm2.13:72.3: Cittaṃ abhinīharati abhininnāmetīti parikammacittaṃ abhinīharati ceva abhininnāmeti ca.
vsm2.13:73.2: Devatānañhi sucaritakammanibbattaṃ pittasemharuhirādīhi apalibuddhaṃ upakkilesavimuttatāya dūrepi ārammaṇaṃ sampaṭicchanasamatthaṃ dibbaṃ pasādacakkhu hoti.
vsm2.13:73.3: Idañcāpi vīriyabhāvanābalanibbattaṃ ñāṇacakkhu tādisamevāti dibbasadisattā dibbaṃ.
vsm2.13:73.4: Dibbavihāravasena paṭiladdhattā attanā ca dibbavihārasannissitattāpi dibbaṃ.
vsm2.13:74.1: Yo hi cutimattameva passati, na upapātaṃ. So ucchedadiṭṭhiṃ gaṇhāti.
vsm2.13:74.2: Yo upapātamattameva passati, na cutiṃ, so navasattapātubhāvadiṭṭhiṃ gaṇhāti.
vsm2.13:74.3: Yo pana tadubhayaṃ passati, so yasmā duvidhampi taṃ diṭṭhigataṃ ativattati. Tasmāssa taṃdassanaṃ diṭṭhivisuddhihetu hoti.
vsm2.13:75.2: mānusakaṃ vā maṃsacakkhuṃ atikkantattā atikkantamānusakanti veditabbaṃ.
vsm2.13:75.3: Tena dibbena cakkhunā visuddhena atikkantamānusakena. Satte passatīti manussānaṃ maṃsacakkhunā viya satte oloketi.
vsm2.13:76.1: Cavamāne upapajjamāneti ettha cutikkhaṇe upapattikkhaṇe vā dibbacakkhunā daṭṭhuṃ na sakkā.
vsm2.13:76.2: Ye pana āsannacutikā idāni cavissanti, te cavamānā.
vsm2.13:76.3: Ye ca gahitapaṭisandhikā sampatinibbattāva, te upapajjamānāti adhippetā.
vsm2.13:76.4: Te evarūpe cavamāne ca upapajjamāne ca passatīti dasseti.
vsm2.13:77.1: Hīneti mohanissandayuttattā hīnānaṃ jātikulabhogādīnaṃ vasena hīḷite ohīḷite oññāte avaññāte.
vsm2.13:77.4: Dubbaṇṇeti dosanissandayuttattā aniṭṭhākantaamanāpavaṇṇayutte. Anabhirūpe virūpetipi attho.
vsm2.13:77.5: Sugateti sugatigate. Alobhanissandayuttattā vā aḍḍhe mahaddhane.
vsm2.13:77.6: Duggateti duggatigate. Lobhanissandayuttattā vā dalidde appannapāne.
vsm2.13:78.1: Yathākammupageti yaṃ yaṃ kammaṃ upacitaṃ, tena tena upagate.
vsm2.13:79.2: idha bhikkhu heṭṭhā nirayābhimukhaṃ ālokaṃ vaḍḍhetvā nerayike satte passati mahādukkhamanubhavamāne.
vsm2.13:79.4: So evaṃ manasikaroti ‘‘kiṃ nu kho kammaṃ katvā ime sattā etaṃ dukkhaṃ anubhavantī’’ti.
vsm2.13:79.5: Athassa idaṃ nāma katvāti taṃkammārammaṇaṃ ñāṇaṃ uppajjati.
vsm2.13:79.6: Tathā uparidevalokābhimukhaṃ ālokaṃ vaḍḍhetvā nandanavanamissakavanaphārusakavanādīsu satte passati mahāsampattiṃ anubhavamāne.
vsm2.13:79.8: So evaṃ manasikaroti ‘‘kiṃ nu kho kammaṃ katvā ime sattā etaṃ sampattiṃ anubhavantī’’ti.
vsm2.13:79.9: Athassa idaṃ nāma katvāti taṃkammārammaṇaṃ ñāṇaṃ uppajjati.
vsm2.13:80.3: Dibbacakkhupādakāneva hi imāni dibbacakkhunā saheva ijjhanti.
vsm2.13:81.1: Kāyaduccaritenātiādīsu duṭṭhu caritaṃ, duṭṭhaṃ vā caritaṃ kilesapūtikattāti duccaritaṃ.
vsm2.13:81.2: Kāyena duccaritaṃ, kāyato vā uppannaṃ duccaritanti kāyaduccaritaṃ, itaresupi eseva nayo.
vsm2.13:82.1: Ariyānaṃ upavādakāti buddhapaccekabuddhasāvakānaṃ ariyānaṃ antamaso gihisotāpannānampi anatthakāmā hutvā antimavatthunā vā guṇaparidhaṃsanena vā upavādakā akkosakā garahakāti vuttaṃ hoti.
vsm2.13:83.1: Tattha natthi imesaṃ samaṇadhammo, assamaṇā eteti vadanto antimavatthunā upavadati.
vsm2.13:83.2: Natthi imesaṃ jhānaṃ vā vimokkho vā maggo vā phalaṃ vātiādīni vadanto guṇaparidhaṃsanavasena upavadatīti veditabbo.
vsm2.13:83.3: So ca jānaṃ vā upavadeyya ajānaṃ vā, ubhayathāpi ariyūpavādova hoti.
vsm2.13:84.2: Aññatarasmiṃ kira gāme eko thero ca daharabhikkhu ca piṇḍāya caranti.
vsm2.13:84.5: So cintesi ‘‘ayaṃ yāgu mayhaṃ sappāyā, yāva na sītalā hoti, tāva naṃ pivāmī’’ti.
vsm2.13:84.6: So manussehi ummāratthāya āhaṭe dārukhaṇḍe nisīditvā pivi.
vsm2.13:84.7: Itaro taṃ jigucchanto ‘‘atikhuddābhibhūto mahallako, amhākaṃ lajjitabbakaṃ akāsī’’ti āha.
vsm2.13:84.8: Thero gāme caritvā vihāraṃ gantvā daharabhikkhuṃ āha ‘‘atthi te, āvuso, imasmiṃ sāsane patiṭṭhā’’ti?
vsm2.13:84.10: Tena hāvuso, uparimaggatthāya vāyāmaṃ mā akāsi. Khīṇāsavo tayā upavaditoti.
vsm2.13:84.11: So taṃ khamāpesi. Tenassa taṃ kammaṃ pākatikaṃ ahosi.
vsm2.13:85.1: Tasmā yo aññopi ariyaṃ upavadati, tena gantvā sace attanā vuḍḍhataro hoti, ukkuṭikaṃ nisīditvā ‘‘ahaṃ āyasmantaṃ idañcidañca avacaṃ, taṃ me khamāhī’’ti khamāpetabbo.
vsm2.13:85.2: Sace navakataro hoti, vanditvā ukkuṭikaṃ nisīditvā añjaliṃ paggahetvā ‘‘ahaṃ, bhante, tumhe idañcidañca avacaṃ, taṃ me khamathā’’ti khamāpetabbo.
vsm2.13:85.3: Sace disāpakkanto hoti, sayaṃ vā gantvā saddhivihārikādike vā pesetvā khamāpetabbo.
vsm2.13:86.1: Sace ca nāpi gantuṃ, na pesetuṃ sakkā hoti, ye tasmiṃ vihāre bhikkhū vasanti, tesaṃ santikaṃ gantvā sace navakatarā honti, ukkuṭikaṃ nisīditvā, sace vuḍḍhatarā, vuḍḍhe vuttanayeneva paṭipajjitvā ‘‘ahaṃ, bhante, asukaṃ nāma āyasmantaṃ idañcidañca avacaṃ, khamatu me so āyasmā’’ti vatvā khamāpetabbaṃ.
vsm2.13:87.1: Sace ekacārikabhikkhu hoti, nevassa vasanaṭṭhānaṃ, na gataṭṭhānaṃ paññāyati, ekassa paṇḍitassa bhikkhuno santikaṃ gantvā ‘‘ahaṃ, bhante, asukaṃ nāma āyasmantaṃ idañcidañca avacaṃ, taṃ me anussarato vippaṭisāro hoti, kiṃ karomī’’ti vattabbaṃ.
vsm2.13:87.2: So vakkhati ‘‘tumhe mā cintayittha, thero tumhākaṃ khamati, cittaṃ vūpasamethā’’ti.
vsm2.13:87.3: Tenāpi ariyassa gatadisābhimukhena añjaliṃ paggahetvā khamatūti vattabbaṃ.
vsm2.13:88.1: Sace so parinibbuto hoti, parinibbutamañcaṭṭhānaṃ gantvā yāvasivathikaṃ gantvāpi khamāpetabbaṃ.
vsm2.13:88.2: Evaṃ kate neva saggāvaraṇaṃ, na maggāvaraṇaṃ hoti, pākatikameva hotīti.
vsm2.13:89.2: Micchādiṭṭhikammasamādānāti micchādiṭṭhivasena samādinnanānāvidhakammā, ye ca micchādiṭṭhimūlakesu kāyakammādīsu aññepi samādapenti.
vsm2.13:89.3: Ettha ca vacīduccaritaggahaṇeneva ariyūpavāde manoduccaritaggahaṇena ca micchādiṭṭhiyā saṅgahitāyapi imesaṃ dvinnaṃ puna vacanaṃ mahāsāvajjabhāvadassanatthanti veditabbaṃ.
vsm2.13:90.2: Vuttampi cetaṃ ‘‘seyyathāpi, sāriputta, bhikkhu sīlasampanno samādhisampanno paññāsampanno diṭṭheva dhamme aññaṃ ārādheyya, evaṃsampadamidaṃ, sāriputta, vadāmi taṃ vācaṃ appahāya taṃ cittaṃ appahāya taṃ diṭṭhiṃ appaṭinissajjitvā yathābhataṃ nikkhitto, evaṃ niraye’’ti (ma. ni. 1.149).
vsm2.13:90.3: Micchādiṭṭhito ca mahāsāvajjataraṃ nāma aññaṃ natthi.
vsm2.13:90.4: Yathāha ‘‘nāhaṃ, bhikkhave, aññaṃ ekadhammampi samanupassāmi, yaṃ evaṃ mahāsāvajjaṃ, yathayidaṃ, bhikkhave, micchādiṭṭhi. Micchādiṭṭhiparamāni, bhikkhave, vajjānī’’ti (a. ni. 1.310).
vsm2.13:91.3: Atha vā kāyassa bhedāti jīvitindriyassa upacchedā. Parammaraṇāti cuticittato uddhaṃ.
vsm2.13:92.2: Nirayo hi saggamokkhahetubhūtā puññasammatā ayā apetattā, sukhānaṃ vā āyassa abhāvā apāyo.
vsm2.13:92.3: Dukkhassa gati paṭisaraṇanti duggati, dosabahulatāya vā duṭṭhena kammunā nibbattā gatīti duggati.
vsm2.13:92.5: Vinassantā vā ettha patanti saṃbhijjamānaṅgapaccaṅgātipi vinipāto.
vsm2.13:93.2: Tiracchānayoni hi apāyo sugatito apetattā, na duggati mahesakkhānaṃ nāgarājādīnaṃ sambhavato.
vsm2.13:93.4: So hi apāyo ceva duggati ca, sugatito apetattā dukkhassa ca gatibhūtattā. Na tu vinipāto asurasadisaṃ avinipatitattā.
vsm2.13:93.6: So hi yathāvuttena atthena apāyo ceva duggati ca sabbasamussayehi ca vinipatitattā vinipātoti vuccati.
vsm2.13:94.2: Ayaṃ pana viseso, tattha sugatiggahaṇena manussagatipi saṅgayhati.
vsm2.13:94.6: So sabbopi lujjanapalujjanaṭṭhena lokoti ayaṃ vacanattho.
vsm2.13:95.1: Evaṃ passitukāmena pana ādikammikena kulaputtena kasiṇārammaṇaṃ abhiññāpādakajjhānaṃ sabbākārena abhinīhārakkhamaṃ katvā
vsm2.13:95.2: ‘‘tejokasiṇaṃ, odātakasiṇaṃ, ālokakasiṇa’’nti imesu tīsu kasiṇesu aññataraṃ āsannaṃ kātabbaṃ.
vsm2.13:95.5: Sace hi uppādeti, pādakajjhānanissayaṃ hoti, na parikammanissayaṃ.
vsm2.13:95.6: Imesu ca pana tīsu ālokakasiṇaṃyeva seṭṭhataraṃ.
vsm2.13:95.7: Tasmā taṃ vā itaresaṃ vā aññataraṃ kasiṇaniddese vuttanayena uppādetvā upacārabhūmiyaṃyeva ṭhatvā vaḍḍhetabbaṃ.
vsm2.13:96.1: Rūpagataṃ passato panassa parikammassa vāro atikkamati.
vsm2.13:96.4: Athānena punappunaṃ pādakajjhānameva pavisitvā tato vuṭṭhāya āloko pharitabbo.
vsm2.13:96.5: Evaṃ anukkamena āloko thāmagato hotīti ettha āloko hotūti yattakaṃ ṭhānaṃ paricchindati, tattha āloko tiṭṭhatiyeva.
vsm2.13:97.1: Rattiṃ tiṇukkāya maggapaṭipanno cettha puriso opammaṃ.
vsm2.13:97.2: Eko kira rattiṃ tiṇukkāya maggaṃ paṭipajji.
vsm2.13:97.5: So taṃ tiṇukkaṃ bhūmiyaṃ ghaṃsitvā tiṇukkā puna ujjālesi.
vsm2.13:97.6: Sā pajjalitvā purimālokato mahantataraṃ ālokaṃ akāsi.
vsm2.13:97.7: Evaṃ punappunaṃ vijjhātaṃ ujjālayato kamena sūriyo uṭṭhāsi.
vsm2.13:97.8: Sūriye uṭṭhite ukkāya kammaṃ natthīti taṃ chaḍḍetvā divasampi agamāsi.
vsm2.13:98.2: Ukkāya vijjhātāya samavisamānaṃ adassanaṃ viya rūpagataṃ passato parikammassa vārātikkamena āloke antarahite rūpagatānaṃ adassanaṃ.
vsm2.13:98.4: Ukkāya purimālokato mahantatarālokakaraṇaṃ viya puna parikammaṃ karoto balavatarālokapharaṇaṃ.
vsm2.13:98.6: Tiṇukkaṃ chaḍḍetvā divasampi gamanaṃ viya parittālokaṃ chaḍḍetvā thāmagatenālokena divasampi rūpadassanaṃ.
vsm2.13:99.1: Tattha yadā tassa bhikkhuno maṃsacakkhussa anāpāthagataṃ antokucchigataṃ hadayavatthunissitaṃ heṭṭhāpathavītalanissitaṃ tirokuṭṭapabbatapākāragataṃ paracakkavāḷagatanti idaṃ rūpaṃ ñāṇacakkhussa āpāthaṃ āgacchati, maṃsacakkhunā dissamānaṃ viya hoti, tadā dibbacakkhu uppannaṃ hotīti veditabbaṃ.
vsm2.13:100.3: So hi yasmā yattha yattha āloko hotūti adhiṭṭhāti, taṃ taṃ pathavīsamuddapabbate vinivijjhitvāpi ekālokaṃ hoti,
vsm2.13:100.4: athassa tattha bhayānakāni yakkharakkhasādirūpāni passato bhayaṃ uppajjati.
vsm2.13:101.2: Vuttappakārametaṃ rūpamārammaṇaṃ katvā manodvārāvajjane uppajjitvā niruddhe tadeva rūpaṃ ārammaṇaṃ katvā cattāri pañca vā javanāni uppajjantīti sabbaṃ purimanayeneva veditabbaṃ.
vsm2.13:101.5: Tena sahajātaṃ ñāṇaṃ sattānaṃ cutūpapāte ñāṇantipi dibbacakkhuñāṇantipi vuccatīti.
